teaching.title: Peer Programming Mentor
bullets: Explained worked examples involving variables and conditionals as a peer programming mentor under a course instructor's supervision.
Helped peers trace short programs step by step, covering introductory topics including lists and arrays.

projects.title: Study Planner Interface
bullets: Built a local browser interface with form inputs for a study planner using JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
Implemented event handling and input validation, and tested keyboard interaction alongside alternate input cases.

projects.title: Course Planner
bullets: Documented how records are added, searched, and updated in a Python course planner project.
Added input checks and handled invalid entries within the course planner as an individual programming project.
